title: Structure–property relationships of flexible, non-isocyanate polyurethane foams from lignin and castor oil-based reagents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38056-38068
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05582B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kathryn Evancho, Richard S. Reiner, Biljana M. Bujanovic, Srikanth Pilla, James Sternberg
This work demonstrates the use of kraft lignin as an effective raw material for flexible non-isocyanate polyurethane (NIPU) foams, reaching densities below 100 kg m−3 while displaying flexible compression properties.
